_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for street-sign product styling. Confirmed by Max 2026-07-26.
recolour-sign.ps1 reads this file - do not duplicate these values in a script.
The heart is an EXACT SKU match, never a prefix. Sibling SKUs are different
products: 36961-1 Engagement and 36961-2 Retirement share the 36961 base and get
NO heart. Prefix matching would put a red heart on a retirement sign.
build.py draws the heart whenever line 1 contains an ampersand, because that is
where the locked signature unit sits. It has no idea what SKU it is building.
That is why heart removal has to happen here, from the SKU.
2026-08-06: the store was re-SKU'd. ST-001-MR, ST-002-VAL, ST-003-FAM and
ST-516-YD are the SAME products as 36961, 36965-3, 36965 and 36961-1, verified
against the live product catalogue by handle and title. Their rules are carried
over from Max's 2026-07-26 confirmation. The old SKUs stay for old open orders.
_colourNote: Eyedropped from the production PSDs. Validated because black comes back as the
known-good #010101 from the approved Large spec.
Three near-identical blues exist in the source files (#799CAA / #799DAB /
#7A9EAC). That is eyedropper drift, not three products - normalised to one.

_comment: Size upgrades are sold as their own line items. The SIGN LINE's own Size
attribute is authoritative (verified against 30 live orders 2026-08-06: every
Medium/Large sign carries the matching upgrade line). The planner uses these
only as a cross-check - a mismatch is a review flag, never a silent fix.
Order lines that support a sign sale but are never printed and never a sign
themselves. The planner ignores them EXCEPT for the size cross-check above.
Without this list the unknown-sign detector would flag every size upgrade,
because their product handles contain 'street-sign'.
Bundle OFFER lines are one line item that means SEVERAL signs. The planner
cannot expand one safely, so any order carrying one is flagged NEEDS
ATTENTION as a whole and nothing in it is planned automatically.
How the planner spots a sign it cannot classify: SKU prefix ST-, or
'street sign' in the product title or handle. Anything caught here that is
not in products{} above goes in the NEEDS ATTENTION list - visibly excluded,
never silently dropped, never guessed. London / Train / Grandparent / Xmas /
Teacher / Halloween / Football signs all land here on purpose until Max
classifies them or makes them by hand.

unknownSku._comment: An unlisted SKU is a product nobody has classified. Refuse rather than guess - a wrong heart or a wrong colour is a reprint.
